final_response: I have responded to Riley Stone about the urgent webhook retry complaint, acknowledging the issue, letting them know it's been logged as a high-priority ticket, and that our engineering team is investigating the problem.

args.body:
Dear Riley,

Thank you for bringing the webhook retry issue to our attention. I understand this is blocking your users and we treat this as a high priority.

I've logged this as ticket T-ext-E_CH_2_002 and our engineering team is currently investigating the webhook retry mechanism. We'll provide you with an update on the resolution timeline as soon as we have more information.

In the meantime, if there are any specific error messages or patterns you've observed with the webhook failures, please share those details as they could help us accelerate the investigation.

We appreciate your patience and will keep you updated on our progress.

Best regards
